decisions.title: Create pick-your-ai-datasets as the dataset and benchmark directory research repository
decisions.rationale: Research #509 routing row G11 proposes a standalone datasets repository; existing T5 #32 and T6 #36 keep their decision rules.
decisions.acceptance_requirement: Independent non-author approval of the foundation pull request

decisions.title: Represent program, epics and work packages as native issues; tasks and subtasks as checklists
decisions.rationale: Native sub-issues carry independently reviewable outcomes; smaller steps stay in nested checklists so they are not duplicated as issues.
decisions.acceptance_requirement: Independent non-author approval of the foundation pull request

decisions.title: Store metadata, evidence pointers and checksums only; never dataset contents
decisions.rationale: Restricted, personal or unlicensed material must not enter a public repository.
decisions.acceptance_requirement: Independent non-author approval of the foundation pull request

decisions.title: Apply the organization contributor rulesets and research team grants
decisions.rationale: Matches the organization CONTRIBUTING.md role model used by the other research repositories.
decisions.acceptance_requirement: Independent non-author approval of the foundation pull request

decisions.title: Use the fifteen Project fields defined in project-backlog.json as the triage model
decisions.rationale: Initial values are setup values; live triage is preserved and never reset by reconciliation.
decisions.acceptance_requirement: Independent non-author approval of the foundation pull request
